description.text: Mid-air jumps available before you next touch the ground.
Crash forward and hammer the ground, hurling every nearby foe away as you lunge through them.
Strike your golden body like a great bell. The resonating toll rings out, battering nearby foes and leaving them weakened and slowed.
Every blow you land feeds the fire: drain a sliver of life from each foe you strike.
Below two-thirds health, fury grants Strength I and Speed I.
Below 40% health, the fury deepens to Strength II and Speed II.
On the brink at 25% health, you become an Asura: Strength III and Speed III.
While guarding with stamina to spare, incoming damage is reduced by 90%.
Press jump in mid-air to step off the air itself, up to twice before landing. Keeps your momentum.
While your Qi runs deep, the pressure behind every palm-strike swells: deal 30% more damage as long as your core is at least half full.
While your guard is raised, blows that reach you rebound on the attacker with half their force.
Your inner core has been widened and tempered: Qi now circulates and replenishes even as you move and fight.
The Iron Body art perfected into the Diamond Body: blows that land barely register. +6 armor toughness.
Call down a far greater cyclone than the Typhoon: a towering vortex that drags in, batters and hurls everything skyward.
You drift like a leaf and never take fall damage.
Blink forward in a flash of steel to close distance or escape.
Condense your Qi into a blade of pure energy and loose it: a swift bolt that detonates on impact. Costs 40 Qi.
Your body is brittle: maximum health is reduced by 3 hearts.
Erupt into a battle-fury: Strength II, Speed II and Resistance I for 6 seconds.
Burst forward on a gust of wind. Aim upward to vault into the air.
Forge the golden body within: near-total protection (Resistance V) for 5 seconds.
Raise your guard. While held you are rooted (Slowness) but absorb almost all damage, draining stamina to do so. Press again to lower it.
Holding your guard steadily drains stamina.
Strikes against your tempered body rebound on the attacker.
Flood your body with Qi to steel it: Resistance II for 6 seconds. Costs 30 Qi.
Stamp the earth and call forth a roaring cyclone that drags foes in, batters them and hurls them skyward.
Gather every shred of sword-qi into one immense crescent and loose it. The blow cleaves through all it touches. Requires a sword in hand.
Call a ring of spectral blades to rain down around you, stabbing into the ground and cutting every foe nearby. Requires a sword in hand.
All that conditioning weighs on you: you move a little slower.
A sword immortal does not fall to their death; you take no fall damage.
While meditating (crouched), your circulating Qi mends your wounds.
A defender is not so easily shoved out of stance.
Conditioned flesh turns blades: +8 armor.
Your sword recovers almost instantly between cuts.
The wind lifts your every step: you spring from the ground higher than any earthbound fighter.
The temple's mightiest open-hand art: a thunderous palm that erupts in a wide shockwave, crushing and flinging every foe around you. Costs 30 stamina.
Crouch and be still to gather Qi far faster than it returns on its own.
Slam a shockwave into everything around you, damaging and tossing nearby foes. Costs 20 stamina.
Each blow you actually block rings out with a shield clang and bites a chunk from your stamina.
Your inner energy. Spent on palm arts and replenished slowly, or quickly through meditation.
Your tempered body no longer merely shrugs off blows: it hurls their force back twice as hard upon the attacker.
Step onto your blade and take to the sky. Toggle the art on, then double-tap jump to fly freely; jump to rise, sneak to descend.
Master of weightlessness at last: step onto the sky itself and fly where you will.
You stand like a mountain and are hard to knock back.
Your reserves have deepened into a sea: stamina trickles back even while your guard is held, so you no longer run dry mid-stance.
Spread your robes to the wind and glide freely, as though borne on wings.
Fuels both your guard and your skills. Recovers only when you lower your guard.
You move with the lightness of the wind, always a step quicker.
With a blade in hand you strike far harder. Empty-handed, you are merely mortal.
Blade and heart become one. So long as a sword rests in your hand, your every strike bites deeper. +2 attack damage.
Loose a crescent of sword-energy that flies out and cuts at range. Requires a sword in hand.

Hurl a spectral blade along your aim. Where it strikes, a storm of swords rains from the sky and stabs into the ground all around, cutting and hurling every foe caught in the storm. Requires a sword in hand.
At death's door below 15% health, your fury refuses to let the body fail: Regeneration II and immunity to fire.
On the brink at 25% health, nothing can move you: 100% knockback resistance.
Hurl a bolt of compressed Qi that strikes at range. Costs 25 Qi.
Cling to and climb vertical surfaces like a swallow on a cliff.
Unleash the Asura within: a shockwave of raw fury detonates around you, savaging and flinging away everything nearby.
